question: If you ___ (finish) your homework, we will watch a film.
explanation: First Conditional: после if используется Present Simple, а в главной части will.

question: If I ___ (know) her phone number, I would call her.
explanation: Second Conditional: в части с if используется Past Simple, в главной would + глагол.

question: We will miss the bus if we ___ (not / leave) now.
explanation: В условии First Conditional не используется will: if we don't leave.

question: If he ___ (have) more free time, he would learn Spanish.
explanation: Second Conditional описывает воображаемую ситуацию: If + Past Simple, ... would + V.

question: If you mix red and blue, you ___ (get) purple.
explanation: Zero Conditional для факта: If + Present Simple, ... Present Simple.

question: I would go to the party if I ___ (not / be) so tired.
explanation: В гипотетических предложениях с глаголом be традиционно используется were для всех лиц. В разговорном английском встречается was, но стандартная форма здесь — weren't.

question: If you ___ (call) me earlier, I would have picked you up.
explanation: Third Conditional: в условии используется Past Perfect — had called.

question: If I had seen the sign, I ___ (turn) left.
explanation: Результат Third Conditional: would have + V3, поэтому would have turned.

question: If she ___ (not / forget) her keys, she would be inside now.
explanation: Mixed Conditional: условие в прошлом требует Past Perfect — hadn't forgotten.

question: I ___ (be) at the beach now if I had taken the flight yesterday.
explanation: Следствие относится к настоящему (now), поэтому используется would + V: would be.

question: If we ___ (book) tickets earlier, we wouldn't have paid so much.
explanation: Third Conditional: условие в прошлом выражается через Past Perfect — had booked.

question: If I hadn't missed the last bus, I ___ (not / be) at home now.
explanation: Условие в прошлом, результат в настоящем (now): would + V, то есть wouldn't be.

question: She enjoys ___ (paint) landscapes on weekends.
explanation: После enjoy используется герундий: enjoy + V-ing.

question: He promised ___ (send) me the photos.
explanation: После promise используется инфинитив: promise + to + V.

question: You should avoid ___ (drive) during rush hour.
explanation: После avoid используется герундий: avoid + V-ing.

question: They decided ___ (not / attend) the meeting.
explanation: После decide используется to + инфинитив; отрицание ставится перед to.

question: He stopped ___ (smoke) last year and feels much better.
explanation: Stop + V-ing означает перестать делать: he stopped smoking — бросил курить.

question: I clearly remember ___ (meet) her at the conference.
explanation: Remember + V-ing означает помнить, что уже сделал: remember meeting.

question: The novel ___ (publish) in 1995.
explanation: Past Simple Passive для единственного числа: was + V3.

question: Fresh vegetables ___ (sell) at this market every morning.
explanation: Present Simple Passive с множественным числом: are + V3.

question: The missing dog ___ (find) near the river yesterday.
explanation: Past Simple Passive для единственного числа: was + V3.

question: French ___ (teach) at our school.
explanation: Present Simple Passive: French is taught; V3 от teach — taught.

question: The cake ___ (eat) before the guests arrived.
explanation: Past Simple Passive для единственного числа: was + V3; V3 от eat — eaten.

question: These roads ___ (repair) last summer.
explanation: Past Simple Passive с множественным числом: were + V3.

question: The doctor ___ treated me was very kind.
explanation: Для человека в роли подлежащего используем who.

question: The film, ___ we watched last night, was excellent.
explanation: Это non-defining clause (выделено запятыми). В таком случае используется which, а не that.

question: I met a student ___ mother teaches at our university.
explanation: Whose выражает принадлежность: student whose mother.

question: This is the café ___ we first met.
explanation: Where используется для места: the café where we met.

question: The painting, ___ was bought in Paris, is now in a museum.
explanation: В non-defining предложении с запятыми используется which, но не that.

question: The man ___ stole my bike was caught.
explanation: Для человека используем who: the man who stole my bike.

question: "I need more time," she said. → She said that she ___ more time.
explanation: Present Simple сдвигается в Past Simple: need → needed.

question: "I will send the report tomorrow," he said. → He said that he ___ the report the next day.
explanation: Will сдвигается в would: will send → would send.

question: "We are waiting outside," they said. → They said that they ___ outside.
explanation: Present Continuous сдвигается в Past Continuous: are waiting → were waiting.

question: Yesterday, she said: "I saw the film last night." → She said that she ___ the film the night before.
explanation: По правилу backshift Past Simple сдвигается в Past Perfect: saw → had seen.

question: "You can borrow my umbrella," he said. → He said that I ___ borrow his umbrella.
explanation: Can сдвигается в could: can borrow → could borrow.

question: She ___ me that the train was late.
explanation: Tell требует дополнения: tell somebody that...; say используется без него.
